title: fix(plugin-form,fields,i18n): the record page's line-items panel and the grid field speak the user's language (objectui#11131)
body:
Fixes #11131

Clause-②: no

## What

Under a zh session the record page's `record:line_items` panel (`LineItemsPanel`) rendered its default title `Line Items` and its `Save` / `Saving…` button in English. The line-items grid (`GridField`) did the same for its Add button (`Add line`), the list-mode empty text (`No items yet — click “Add” to begin.`) and the read-only empty state (`No items`). They now read the locale packs.

Only the defaults move. An authored `title` or `add_label` still wins, and an authored `add_label` is also the label the empty text names. English output is byte-identical to the literals it replaces, with and without an i18n provider.

## Where each string goes

| Site | String | Key | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LineItemsPanel` title | `Line Items` | `form.lineItems.title` | new: `form.masterDetail.lineItem` is the singular row noun (`Line item`), a different string |
| `LineItemsPanel` button | `Save` | `common.save` | reused |
| `LineItemsPanel` button, in flight | `Saving…` | `detail.saving` | reused, the key `MasterDetailForm`'s Save already reads |
| `GridField` Add button | `Add line` | `fields.grid.addLine` | new: no pack key says "Add line" (`detail.add` is `Add`) |
| `GridField` list-mode empty text | `No items yet — click “{{label}}” to begin.` | `fields.grid.noItemsAddHint` | new, one key with a `{{label}}` hole |
| its hole, when no `add_label` is authored | `Add` | `detail.add` | reused |
| `GridField` read-only empty state | `No items` | `fields.grid.noItems` | new: `appDesigner.navNoPreviewItems` has the same English but belongs to the app designer's nav preview, and `list.noItems` is `No items found` |

The four new keys are in all ten packs.

## Which translation path, and why

**Panel: its own `useLineItemsTranslation` table, not `useFormChromeTranslation`.** The dispatch asked for one of the two, not both. The panel already owned a `createSafeTranslation` hook (for the malformed-filter sentence), and `formChrome.ts` states the precedent for exactly that case: `WizardForm`, `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` have hooks of their own and carry the rows they read. The panel's table now carries `form.lineItems.title`, `common.save` and `detail.saving` next to `view.malformedFilter`. Using `useFormChromeTranslation` instead would have meant editing `formChrome.ts`, which is outside the claim's declared file surface, to add the title row and move the malformed-filter row. The triage direction names `useFormChromeTranslation`, and this choice departs from that name. It is flagged in the report, not settled silently here.

**Grid: `useFieldTranslation` with an inline `defaultValue` at each call site.** This is the fields package's own path, which the grid already reads for its date cells. An inline default is what `createSafeTranslation`'s provider-less fallback renders for a key its table lacks. `pnpm check:i18n-keys` holds each one to its `en` value, and its interpolation-parity rule holds the call site's arguments to the `{{label}}` hole. Rows in `FIELD_DEFAULTS` (`useFieldTranslation.ts`) would also have worked, but that file is outside the declared surface.

## Tests

Pins, new:
- `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.i18nChrome-11131.test.tsx`: under zh, the default title reads 明细行, the idle button 保存, the in-flight button 保存中… and the grid's Add button 添加行. A read-only panel over no rows shows 暂无条目. CONTROL: an authored `title` renders as written.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.i18nChrome-11131.test.tsx`: under zh, the Add button reads 添加行, the list-mode empty text reads 暂无条目，点击“添加”开始添加。 and the read-only empty state reads 暂无条目. CONTROL: an authored `add_label` is the button label and fills the empty text's hole.
- Two `.no-provider` companions, one per package. With no provider mounted they pin the English byte for byte: `Line Items`, `Save`, `Add line`, `No items`, `No items yet — click “Add” to begin.`, and an authored label in the hole. Each is its own file because an `I18nProvider` mount registers react-i18next's module-global instance for the rest of its file.

An existing pin was updated: `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` is a census of the de pack's „…“ spans. The new de `noItemsAddHint` quotes the label with a matched pair, so the count goes from 68 to 69 spans and the open / close identity from 68 / 68 / 0 to 69 / 69 / 0. Its comment names the key, following the file's own convention. This file is outside the claim's list. It moved because the de value adds a quoted span, not by choice.

Reverse verification, run with the fix committed: both source files were checked out from the base `db11afd49`, keeping the new keys and pins. An on-disk grep confirmed it (title key 1 → 0, `'Line Items'` literal present, `fields.grid.addLine` 1 → 0). Run over the four pin files, the result was **7 failed | 5 passed (12)**, which was the predicted direction. All seven zh cases went red, the two CONTROLs included, since each also asserts pack chrome. All five provider-less cases stayed green because the English is unchanged. After restoring with `git checkout HEAD --`, the blob hashes matched HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

Gate ablation: I changed the grid's `noItemsAddHint` inline default by one word through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0). `check:i18n-keys` then went to exit 1 with `[default-value-drift] fields.grid.noItemsAddHint`. The file was restored and matched the HEAD blob.

At `370aaf443` (the final commit):
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/ packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx` gave **96 files passed, 1410 tests passed, 13 skipped**. This is a declared narrowing.
- At `8cf648cfe` I ran the whole of `packages/plugin-form/`, `packages/fields/` and `packages/i18n/` plus the mirror test: 444 files, 6466 tests passed and 2 failed. Both failures were the de census above, fixed in `5081cc63f`. The only later commit adds the changeset, which no test reads.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`, then `@object-ui/fields`, then `@object-ui/plugin-form`, all exit 0. These ran after building plugin-form's dependency closure with `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-form^...'` (11/11 tasks). Each package's `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new test files (`--listFilesOnly`).
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 17 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files gave exit 0: 0 errors and 43 warnings, all on lines this diff does not touch. The file count comes from `--format json`, which reports all 17 as linted and none ignored. `eslint.config.js` configures no type-aware linting (no `projectService` or `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.
- Exit 0 for `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (4 keys added, 0 `en` values changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (no new key among the candidates), `check-changeset-presence`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check:changeset-claims`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The rest of the line-items chrome is still English, in the same two files.** This is out of scope here and goes in the report as a finding for the seat, with its reach measured by an uncommitted zh render probe. `LineItemsPanel` still has `Loading…`, `Save the record first to add line items.`, `This record’s line items have not been loaded.`, the `Failed to load / save line items` fallbacks and the no-child-object hint. `GridField` still has `Total`, `Columns`, `Optional columns`, `Computed` and the row actions' `aria-label` / `title` pairs. Under zh the probe saw `Save the record first to add line items.` and the `Total` footer in English. The row-action pairs disagree with each other (`Duplicate row` vs `Duplicate line`), so choosing their keys is not purely mechanical.
- **`MasterDetailForm`'s collection heading** (`d.title` falling back to a `Line Items` literal) is the same string. The probe measured it in English under zh too. That file is held by the claim on objectui#11132 (a different defect, the totals' currency sign), so it is not touched here. After this PR the fix can reuse `form.lineItems.title`.
- The empty text's hole defaults to `detail.add` (`Add`), while the button defaults to `Add line`. That mismatch predates this PR and is kept byte-identical. Its only list-mode producer, `MasterDetailForm`'s in-form collection, always passes `add_label`, so no rendered screen shows the two disagreeing.
